vehicles.heroTitle: Moon Sweepers Vehicles — Prices, Capacity & Upgrades
vehicles.description: Choose a sweeper for your cleaning route or a transport for your crew. Compare five vehicles by price, hopper size, speed and capsule slots, then check garage upgrades and trick rewards.

cleaning-tools.heroTitle: Moon Sweepers Cleaning Tools — Prices, Width & Capacity
cleaning-tools.description: Still using a brush, or ready for a wider broom? Compare six tools by price, dust capacity, cleaning width and stroke time to see what changes with your next purchase.

containers.heroTitle: Moon Sweepers Containers — Capacity & Upgrade Costs
containers.description: Spend more time cleaning between trips to unload. Compare container levels for each hand tool, including capacity gains, individual prices and how Dust Compactor affects storage.

suit-gear.heroTitle: Moon Sweepers Suit Gear — Movement, Lighting & Slots
suit-gear.description: Need another tool slot, better movement or a way to work in darkness? Compare suit gear by effect and upgrade cost before choosing what your crew should unlock next.

joonas-robots.heroTitle: Moon Sweepers Robots — Joonas & Docked Vacuums
joonas-robots.description: Choose between cleaning around a fixed dock and sending J.O.O.N.A.S. across the Moon. Compare prices, working areas and storage, then check where the collected dust needs to go.

buildings.heroTitle: Moon Sweepers Buildings — Pieces, Prices & Placement
buildings.description: Plan a base that leaves room for work and expansion. Browse 98 build-menu pieces, compare structure prices and finishes, and check movement and refund rules before rebuilding.
